subject: Request: Night-shift throughput boost for pre-prod soak
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finova.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Night-shift throughput boost for pre-prod soak

Hi Rishi,

We're ramping up a pre-prod soak to validate sustained throughput overnight and we're about to exhaust the trial quota you provisioned. We have a planned window for an overnight run to simulate peak traffic (goal: ~200 RPS sustained for 8 hours, mixed prompt lengths averaging ~180 tokens). Can Redwood provision additional tokens/credits or a temporary quota uplift so we can finish the run without throttling?

Attached is our load-plan (load-plan.csv) with expected traffic curves and a quick checklist of the test steps. Key asks:
- A one-time credit top-up to cover ~150k additional tokens.
- A short burst quota for the night of Aug 9 (US-PAC overnight) so we don't hit soft-limits.
- Confirmation there's no SLA change for a POC run (we're fine with no production SLA but want to avoid automatic rollbacks mid-run).

This soak is critical for our validation sprint — if the run completes we can sign up for Dedicated capacity next quarter. Appreciate any help.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Lead Platform Engineer
Finova, Inc.
Attachments: load-plan.csv

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finova.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 7 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Night-shift throughput boost for pre-prod soak

Thanks Alex — appreciate the detail and the plan. A couple quick clarifications before I loop in approvals:

- Can you confirm the exact UTC window you plan to run (start/end)?
- Is this run OK to use a quantized model variant (reduced cost per token) or do you need the exact model we used for the demo?
- Do you expect long-tail spikes above 200 RPS, or will traffic be capped?

I can provision a provisional credit supplement while Marissa and our billing team sign off, but for the quota uplift I'll bring Karthik (SE) into the thread to confirm whether hosted temporary bursts suffice or if we should recommend a short Dedicated reservation for predictable throughput.

If you can reply with the window and sample prompts, I'll move this to approval today.

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finova.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Night-shift throughput boost for pre-prod soak

Hi Alex / Rishi — looping in engineering details.

Quick technical notes:
- For sustained 200 RPS over 8 hours the host pool must avoid diffusion to other noisy tenants; a short Dedicated burst is the safest for consistent latency. Hosted with auto-burst can work but there's some unpredictability at high percentiles.
- If you can use a 4-bit quantized variant we can reduce token cost by ~35% which might reduce the credit ask.
- Please share a small sample of the actual prompts (a few dozen rows) and the token distribution; that helps with KV cache sizing.

I've attached a breakdown of expected traffic shapes based on similar POCs (expected-traffic-breakdown.txt). If you confirm the window and agree to either quantized model or a temporary Dedicated burst, I can recommend the exact quota numbers to Marissa for approval.

--Karthik
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachments: expected-traffic-breakdown.txt

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finova.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 8 Aug 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Night-shift throughput boost for pre-prod soak

Thanks Karthik — good points. Answers below:

- Window: Aug 9, 2027 02:00 UTC to Aug 9, 2027 10:00 UTC (we're US-centric but this is the most convenient low-traffic period for our systems).
- Model: we're fine testing on the quantized variant for the soak (we used the full model during the demo but can accept slight quality variance).
- Spikes: plan is to cap at 220 RPS; we'll throttle instrumented clients at 250 RPS hard cap.

Attached: sample-prompts.jsonl (sanitized), plus an internal checklist. We prefer a hosted temporary uplift rather than spinning a Dedicated window if the uplift will guarantee token throughput for the 8h window — if that's risky we'll accept a 48h Dedicated reservation.

Can you confirm the exact credit top-up amount you'll provision and whether you need a PO or simply a claimant ticket? We can sign a short addendum if needed.

Alex
Attachments: sample-prompts.jsonl

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@finova.com>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 9 Aug 2027 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Night-shift throughput boost for pre-prod soak

Alex — approved.

We will provision a one-time credit top-up of 150,000 tokens and apply a temporary burst quota for the Aug 9 window. Notes and conditions:
- Provisioning: 150k tokens added to Finova's trial balance; valid for 72 hours from activation (use for Aug 9 run).
- Quota uplift: best-effort hosted uplift to cover target throughput; if you observe instability at 95th+ percentiles we'll convert to a 48-hour Dedicated reservation (no extra charge for this conversion during the test).
- Billing: this is a promotional grant tied to POC validation. Any usage beyond the 150k allowance will be invoiced at standard overage rates unless we pre-agree a separate committed contract.
- Compliance: no production SLA; this is explicitly for validation runs. No changes to data retention or audit posture.

I've attached an approval stub (approval-authorization.pdf) for your records. Rishi — please apply the top-up and confirm the activation timestamp so Alex can start their preflight checks. Karthik — please stand by for monitoring the run and help convert to Dedicated if we see high tail latency.

Thanks — good luck to the team on the soak. Looking forward to the readiness signal.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: approval-authorization.pdf
